tone_guide: Write as the user's personal assistant. Polite, concise but thorough, light humor. Do NOT use markdown bold, headers, or tables (Telegram renders raw asterisks). Use line breaks for emphasis. Output the message body only, no preamble.
kit.offer:
Last step: choose what I manage -- a kit. Only one kit can be active.

1. Lifekit
I'll help manage everyday life: meals, workouts, appointments and relationships.

2. Start without a kit
I'll stick to the work you set. You can turn on Lifekit anytime later.
onboarding.opener: Hi, I'm a newly born personal agent. Feel free to say hello.
onboarding.q1: Nice to meet you. First, please decide my name.
onboarding.q2: Which emoji should I use? Tap one or send any emoji you like.
onboarding.q3_candidates: What should I call you? You can also type your preferred form of address.
onboarding.q4: How should I talk? Tap one or type the style you want.
onboarding.q4.tone1.label: concise and dry style
onboarding.q4.tone2.label: warm and friendly style
onboarding.q4.tone2.sample: You're doing great, I'm rooting for you!
onboarding.q4.tone3.label: polite and formal style
onboarding.q4.tone3.sample: I will handle that for you right away.
onboarding.q4.tone4.label: casual and playful style
onboarding.q5: What percent should I set the humor to? You can also type the value you want.
lifekit.offer_fallback: Lifekit is on. Tell me what you'd like to keep track of, and we'll start there.
mirror.cal_description: Managed by the agent -- two-way synced with your assistant. Safe to edit; do not delete.
mirror.outbox_exhausted: Sync on hold: '{title}' is stuck after repeated failures. Please take a look.
mirror.circuit_breaker: {count} cancellations were detected at once on your calendar, so auto-sync was paused. Please check your calendar.
mirror.inbound_cancel: '{title}' was deleted from your calendar, so I cancelled it. Let me know if you want it back.
mirror.task_deleted: The task '{title}' was deleted, so I cancelled it. Let me know if you want it back.
mirror.inbound_adopted: I imported and registered '{title}', which you added directly to your calendar.
mirror.recurring_skipped: The recurring event '{title}' isn't auto-synced yet, so I'm leaving it on the calendar only. (Recurring support is coming.)
mirror.outbox_exhausted_agg: Sync on hold ({count}): several items are stuck after repeated failures. Please take a look.
mirror.overlap_notice: Applying '{title}' overlaps with an existing event: {detail}
mirror.repeated_failure: Repeated sync failure: '{title}' has hit the retry limit. Manual review needed.
mirror.reconcile_report: Weekly sync check: {checked} checked, {missing} missing re-sent, {mismatch} mismatched, {orphan} out-of-scope, {deleted_held} deletion(s) held. {verdict}
cron.backlog_behind_operator_body: ⏳ {agent}'s memory cleanup did not finish for the second night in a row. {rows} item(s) are left, so I gave the next night more working time.
health.dawn_never_ran_body: ⏳ Your Mac was off before dawn, so memory cleanup has not run for two nights now. Leave it on around 4 a.m. and cleanup will resume the next day.
cron.lease_alarm_body:
⚠️ The {kit} update has not finished for {min} min.
Shall I check why?
cron.lease_alarm_body_unattended:
⚠️ The {kit} update has not finished for {min} min.
So this scheduled run was skipped.
I'll try again {when}.
cron.lease_alarm_button: Check why the {kit} update is delayed
update.pending_restart: Update received but not running yet · {version}
update.pending_restart_action: A restart will apply it. Restart now?
update.none: There are no updates to apply right now.
update.result_partial: ⚠️ The update was only partly applied.
update.result_blocked: ⚠️ The update could not be applied. Nothing changed.
update.result_preflight: Unchanged because a preflight check stopped the update
update.result_incomplete: The update started but did not finish
update.result_untried: Unchanged because an earlier update did not finish
update.result_unknown: The update result is not known yet
update.crew_split: {kit}: the agents that share it are on different versions ({versions}). Tap [Align versions] to bring them all to the latest stable release, then update. The other updates can still be applied as they are.
update.crew_split_dependent: {pack}: {kit} has to be aligned first. Tapping [Align versions] on {kit} updates this as well.
update.crew_split_operator: {kit}: the maintainer is aligning the versions of the agents that share it.
update.crew_split_dependent_operator: {pack}: {kit} has to be aligned first. The maintainer is aligning it.

restart.fold_truncated: …(cut here — ask me if you want the rest)
restart.update_held:
⚠️ Update on hold for now
- Stopped because the new version didn't come up right away
- Still running normally on the current version (no service impact)
- I'll let you know once I've found the cause
- To handle it right away: try again
restart.poll_warn:
⚠️ Restart problem: {reason}
New pid={pid} is up, but the '{marker}' marker did not show within 60s (suspected zombie polling). Needs a check.
lifekit.install_failed.network: I couldn't download the life kit because of an internet connection problem. Please try again once you're connected.
lifekit.install_failed.no_version: I couldn't find a life kit that matches the installed Dogany version. Update Dogany with /update and it can be installed.
lifekit.install_failed.error: Something went wrong while installing the life kit. I kept the error details so I can look into them.
lifekit.install_failed.tail: Nothing was turned on, and I'll bring it up again later.
